main_body: multi-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: blue-grey slate roof slope and upper roof section (rows 16-43) with orange trim/cornice at rows 44-45
evidence: The building shows a substantial foreshortened roof top section (rows 16-43), a clear cornice edge (rows 44-45), eave shadow (row 46), and recessed windows/doors along the vertical facade (rows 46-142).

style.evidence: Bricks and roof slates have decent block patterning, but heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormers, chimney, and walls create a stiffer look compared to the softer material-toned outlines and richer per-tile grain of the Beodeul reference.
